snippet.title: SpellHook Teaser
snippet.description: Spellhook on #Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966200/Spellhook Master the art of the hook in Spellhook, a dark fantasy retro fever dream where high-momentum platforming meets chaotic 1-hit-kill combat. Battle friends in 4-player arenas or brave a brutal singleplayer roguelite. Build your tower, craft powerful ability shards, and prepare to hunt a fallen god.
